# Etapa A02 — Identificadores ENEMDU`r render_stage_assurance(report_context$stage_A02, audit_href = "../../audit/reporting/reporte_controles_internos.html#etapa-A02-controles-identificadores")` {#etapa-A02 .rap-assurance-heading}


```{r}
#| label: stage-A02-context

stage_A02 <- report_context$stage_A02
```


## Resumen de identificadores construidos {#etapa-A02-resumen-identificadores}

```{r}
#| label: stage-A02-identifier-summary

identifier_summary_report <- prepare_gt_view(
  stage_A02$identifier_summary,
  column_ids = c(Variable = "Variable_A02"),
  integer_columns = c("Sample_Valid", "Population_Valid", "Distinct_Values")
)

identifier_summary_report |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Variable_A02 = "Variable",
    Description = "Descripción",
    Sample_Valid = unname(reporting_labels[["valid_sample"]]),
    Population_Valid = unname(reporting_labels[["valid_population"]]),
    Distinct_Values = "Valores distintos"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(
      Variable_A02,
      Description
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      Sample_Valid,
      Population_Valid,
      Distinct_Values
    )
  )
```


## Distribución por dominio de estudio {#etapa-A02-distribucion-dominios}

```{r}
#| label: stage-A02-domain-distribution

domain_distribution_report <- prepare_gt_view(
  stage_A02$domain_distribution,
  integer_columns = c("Sample_N", "Expanded_N", "Unique_PSUs")
)

domain_distribution_report |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    dominio = "Dominio",
    area = "Área",
    Sample_N = unname(reporting_labels[["sample"]]),
    Expanded_N = unname(reporting_labels[["population"]]),
    Unique_PSUs = "UPM"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(
      dominio,
      area
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      Sample_N,
      Expanded_N,
      Unique_PSUs
    )
  )
```
